name: A Child's Dream
overview: Aimed at the 4 to 8-year-old age group, the series is a friendly invitation to discover the world of children's dreams. Each episode features a child, ranging from 6 to 12 years old describing and illustrating his / her dream, a bit in the manner of a small tale. Respecting the children's genuine drawing style as well as the spirit of their dream, each episode features an original music score. The children's narration preserves natural emotions, colourful imaginations and the authenticity of the series' style.
